name: Abomination (Immortal)

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.

signatureAbility:
Toxic Husk
Self inflicted Poison stack limit is increased to 12 and Abomination self inflicts 3 Poisons at the start of each fight.
Poison, Petrify, and Acid Burn effects last +[0 - 30]% longer.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Take 100% less damage from Poison effects and the recovery reduction from Poison is 50% less effective.

abilitySections.title: Corrosive Poisons
content: Contact with the Opponent has a 15% chance to inflict them with a Poison Debuff, dealing [9,764.8] Direct Damage over 25 seconds and reducing health recovery by 30%.
If the Opponent reaches 10 Poison Debuffs they are converted into an Acid Burn Passive dealing [63,184] Direct Damage over 5 seconds.

While Acid Burn is active, the Opponent is inflicted with an indefinite non-stacking Poison Debuff dealing 0 damage and reducing health recovery by 30%. While this is active, no additional personal Poison effects can be inflicted onto the Opponent.
When striking an Opponent suffering from Acid Burn, Attacks are Unblockable and deal a burst of [6,892.8] Physical Damage.
When triggering Acid Burn, Abomination inflicts a Petrify Debuff of 60% Potency for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Self Inflicted Poisons - Max 10
content: Every 10th Basic Attack landed by either champion inflicts Abomination with an indefinite Poison Debuff dealing 0 damage.
Each Poison on Abomination grants +[239.13] Physical Resistance, and the first 5 each reduce the potency of the Opponent's Inequity Mastery by 12%.
While Abomination is Poisoned, each time he Blocks an attack the Opponent is inflicted with a Weakness Debuff, reducing Attack Rating by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Activation, inflict a non-stacking Petrify Debuff of 20% Potency for 25 seconds.
Abomination inflicts himself with +4 Poisons. This is increased to +6 if the Toxic Aura is active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Activate Toxic Aura for 10 seconds. While active, consume 1 Poison Debuff on Abomination every 2 second(s) to keep the Aura paused. Consumption is paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
During Toxic Aura standing near the Opponent inflicts 1 Poison Debuff every second, dealing [9,764.8] Direct Damage over 10 seconds and reducing health recovery by 30%.
Each stack of Toxic Aura beyond the first increases the speed that it inflicts Poison by 25%. The Toxic Aura can stack up to 4.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflicts Acid Burn, dealing [63,184] Direct Damage over 5 seconds. Each stack in the Toxic Aura inflicts 1 additional Acid Burn effect.

Until the next time the Toxic Aura expires it becomes enhanced, increasing the time it takes to consume a Poison by 0.5 second(s). This enhancement cannot stack but can be activated even while the Toxic Aura isn't yet active.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Toxic Husk
content: Self inflicted Poison stack limit is increased to 12 and Abomination self inflicts 3 Poisons at the start of each fight.
Poison, Petrify, and Acid Burn effects last +[0 - 30]% longer.
